parameters.name: CancelInProgressTask
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the **IN_PROGRESS** (upgrading) state in the batch. Valid values:

- **true**: Cancel.
- **false** (default): Do not cancel.

parameters.name: CancelNotifiedTask
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the **NOTIFIED** (pushed) state in the batch. Valid values:

- **true**: Cancel.
- **false** (default): Do not cancel.

parameters.name: CancelQueuedTask
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the **QUEUED** (pending push) state in the batch. Valid values:

- **true**: Cancel.
- **false** (default): Do not cancel.

><notice>If this parameter is set to **true** and the **CancelUnconfirmedTask** parameter is specified, only device upgrade jobs in the pending push state are canceled. If this parameter is set to **true** and the **CancelUnconfirmedTask** parameter is not specified, device upgrade jobs in both the pending confirmation and pending push states are canceled.
></notice>

parameters.name: CancelScheduledTask
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to cancel device upgrade jobs in a scheduled upgrade batch. A scheduled upgrade batch is created by calling [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~) with the **ScheduleTime** parameter specified. Valid values:

- **true**: Cancel.
- **false** (default): Do not cancel.

parameters.name: CancelUnconfirmedTask
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to cancel all device upgrade jobs in the **CONFIRM** (pending confirmation) state in the batch. Valid values:

- **true**: Cancel.
- **false**: Do not cancel.

Default value: empty.

><notice>If this parameter is not specified and **CancelQueuedTask** is set to **true**, device upgrade jobs in the pending confirmation state are also canceled. If this parameter is not specified and **CancelQueuedTask** is set to **false**, device upgrade jobs in the pending confirmation state are not canceled.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the upgrade batch.

This is the **JobId** returned when you called [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~) or [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) to create the batch. You can also view this value on the **Firmware Details** page in the IoT Platform console.
